Its dev script is `doppler run -- next dev` (web/package.json), so it takes Next's default. With no explicit -p, Next retries upward on EADDRINUSE and silently starts on 3001 instead, which is why this number needs a record even though no config file states it. Every production app listens on 3000 inside its own Docker network, behind one Caddy, with `expose:` rather than a host `ports:` publish. Deliberately shared — a container network is not a shared namespace — and recorded so that nobody reads the four as a collision.
